Preset gallery

Eight scenes, one engine

Each scene loads the same Verlet solver with different bodies, constraints and tuning. Click any card to launch it straight into the live sandbox — then twist the sliders and break it however you like.

Ball Pit

180 bodies · g 0.6 · bounce 50%

A few hundred elastic balls tumbling under gravity. Stir them with the mouse or fling new ones in.

Launch scene →

Rope Bridge

28-segment span · pinned both ends

A slack suspension bridge between two towers. Drop balls and watch it sag, swing and recover.

Launch scene →

Cloth Flag

26×18 grid · pinned top edge

A pinned cloth grid solved with distance constraints. It ripples, folds, and drapes like fabric.

Launch scene →

Tearable Cloth

28×20 grid · threads snap at 4×

The same cloth, but constraints break when overstretched. Grab and rip holes right through it.

Launch scene →

Box Stack

21 crates · diagonal-braced

Soft-rigid crates braced by diagonal constraints. Build a pyramid, then knock it over.

Launch scene →

Zero-G Drift

90 bodies · g 0 · bounce 92%

Gravity off, near-perfect restitution. Bodies drift forever — click to drop a gravity well.

Launch scene →

Fireworks

recurring bursts · short-lived sparks

Continuous bursts of fading sparks that arc under light gravity. A pure particle flourish.

Launch scene →

Newton's Cradle

5 pendulums · bounce 95%

Five pinned pendulums in a row — a classic momentum demo built from ropes and balls.

Launch scene →
